exposure: antibiotic use during the first week of life
infants with both candidemia and candiduria
cohort: 1890 premature infants with a birthweight between 500 and 1250 g admitted to 95 neonatal intensive care units
finding: Gestational age and male sex were independent risk factors for ICI, while vaginal delivery and antibiotic use during the first week of life increased the risk of ICI in specific gestational age subgroups.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery increased the risk of ICI in infants born at 22-25 weeks and 26-28 weeks gestation.
